description: Append-only, evidence-backed adjudications of FRAME-versus-DERA contradictions (ADR-085, ADR-086). Consumed by the dera-validate mode: an exactly-matching contradiction is reclassified into a non-gating adjudicated category and recorded, with this file's SHA-256, in the validation manifest samples. Two reasons are admitted: replaced_submission (requires a concrete replacement accession with backdating evidence) and deleted_submission (requires replacement_accession null with concrete deletion evidence: present in point-in-time FSDS, absent from the current-regeneration index). Events without such evidence remain gating and unresolved (ADR-085 decision D). This file stands at the five-record bounded-bridge cap recorded in ADR-085/ADR-086: the next adjudication requires a schema successor, not further bridging. DERA remains an independent FRAME validation source only.
